result.topic_en: Pencil tables of oscillation readings for experiments '4 Ohne M.' and '5 10 Stöße', with ink sums and differences of successive readings and linear reductions in an unknown x used to find the equilibrium and deflection.

methods.what: Sums and differences of successive oscillation turning points, used to estimate the equilibrium position (sum) and the amplitude (difference) of a damped oscillation
Means of the sums written as linear expressions in an unknown correction x; the two expressions are subtracted to give the deflection
Numerical correction applied to the linear difference to obtain the final deflection value
Same reduction applied to the experiment with 10 impulses (Stöße), done in two variants
Alternative reduction for the 10-impulse experiment using a different mean
Auxiliary sums of weights and values, divided to obtain a ratio (decrement/amplitude-ratio type quantity)
